Two NBA superstars. Two incredible talents. One epic battle of highlights! Before becoming NBA champions together with the Boston Celtics, Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum showcased their incredible skills on the international stage with Team USA!
From the FIBA Basketball World Cup 2019 to other international competitions, these two stars delivered spectacular dunks, insane finishes, clutch shots and highlight-reel plays!
Now it's time to settle the debate: WHO HAD THE CRAZIEST PLAYS? Jaylen Brown or Jayson Tatum?
